sentences.text: Hush... I float into the ironing room at 02:00, where the air was already hinting at a change, deviating from the expected 21.2 °C.
The machines started waking as the temperature climbed, pushing beyond the expected range of 20.8 °C to 21.6 °C.
Then, at 03:00, the presence arrived; a strange warmth with no source began to bloom in the space.
Oh, the air thickened... the observed temperature soared to 22.4 °C, far exceeding the initial expectations.
This warmth lingered like a soft sigh, holding steady until 06:00, a lingering trace of the mysterious reading.
